theorem InitsUpdatesComm
  {P : PureExpr} {σ σ' σ'' : SemanticStore P}
  {ks ks' : List P.Ident} {vs vs' : List P.Expr} :
  UpdateStates σ ks vs σ' →
  InitStates σ' ks' vs' σ'' →
  ∃ σ₁,
    σ₁ = (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ∧
    InitStates σ ks' vs' σ₁ ∧
    UpdateStates σ₁ ks vs σ'' := by
  intro hu hi
  rcases UpdateStatesUpdated hu ▸ InitStatesUpdated hi
  repeat constructor
  apply updatedStatesInit
  rotate_left
  apply UpdateStatesNotDefMonotone' _ hu
  apply InitStatesNotDefined hi
  apply InitStatesNodup hi
  unfold updatedStates
  rewrite [updatedStatesComm]
  apply updatedStatesUpdate
  rotate_left
  apply updatedStatesDefMonotone
  apply UpdateStatesDefined' hu
  all_goals simp [List.unzip_zip, UpdateStatesLength hu, InitStatesLength hi]
  intro k hk hk'
  injection InitStatesNotDefined hi k hk' ▸ UpdateStatesDefined hu k hk

lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
    (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
  funext x
  false_or_by_contra
  rename_i hx
  have hc := Continuous.inner' (𝕜 := ℝ) f (λ_ => f x) hf continuous_const
  have hp := real_inner_self_nonneg'.lt_of_ne' $ inner_self_eq_zero'.not.mpr hx
  obtain ⟨φ, hs, hk, hd, hn, hφ⟩ := exists_contDiff_tsupport_subset $ hc.continuousAt.eventually_const_lt hp
  refine' ((hd.continuous.fun_mul hc).integral_pos_of_hasCompactSupport_nonneg_nonzero hk.mul_right ?_ $ by rw [hφ, one_mul]; apply hp.ne').ne' $ by
    simpa only [inner_smul_right'] using hg _ $ IsTestFunction.smul_right ⟨hd, hk⟩ contDiff_const
  intro y
  by_cases hy : y ∈ tsupport φ
  · apply mul_nonneg (Set.range_subset_iff.1 hn y).1 (hs hy).le
  · simp [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hy]

lemma time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema {A : ElectromagneticPotential d}
    {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (J : LorentzCurrentDensity d)
    (hJ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ J) (h : IsExtrema 𝓕 A J)
    (t : Time) (x : Space d) (i : Fin d) :
    ∂ₜ (∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i)) t =
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
  have hA3 : ContDiff ℝ (2+1) A := hA.of_le (by decide)
  have hJd := hJ.differentiable (by simp)
  have hBt (j : Fin d) := Space.space_deriv_differentiable_time (i := j)
    (magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff (c := 𝓕.c) A hA3 (j, i)) x
  have hBs := Differentiable.fun_sum (u := Finset.univ) fun j _ => hBt j
  have hJt := LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity_apply_differentiable_time (c := 𝓕.c) hJd x i
  have hEd (j k : Fin d) := Space.deriv_differentiable
    (electricField_apply_contDiff_space (c := 𝓕.c) (i := j) hA3 t) k
  have hJs := LorentzCurrentDensity.chargeDensity_differentiable_space (c := 𝓕.c) hJd t
  have hg := congrArg (fun f => ∂[i] f x)
    (funext fun y => ((isExtrema_iff_gauss_ampere_magneticFieldMatrix hA J hJ).mp h t y).1)
  conv_lhs =>
    enter [1, s]
    rw [Time.deriv_euclid (electricField_differentiable_time hA3.of_succ _),
      time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema hA J hJ h]
  rw [Time.deriv_eq, fderiv_fun_sub (hBs.const_mul _).differentiableAt
    (hJt.const_mul _).differentiableAt, fderiv_const_mul hBs.differentiableAt,
    fderiv_const_mul hJt.differentiableAt, fderiv_fun_sum fun j _ => (hBt j).differentiableAt]
  simp only [_root_.sub_apply, _root_.smul_apply, _root_.sum_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    ← Time.deriv_eq, Space.time_deriv_comm_space_deriv
    (magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff A hA3 _), time_deriv_magneticFieldMatrix _ hA3.of_succ]
  have hs (j : Fin d) :
      ∂[j] (fun y => ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i) y -
        ∂[i] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) y) x =
      ∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x -
        ∂[i] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j)) x := by
    rw [Space.deriv_eq, fderiv_fun_sub (hEd i j).differentiableAt
      (hEd j i).differentiableAt, _root_.sub_apply, ← Space.deriv_eq,
      ← Space.deriv_eq, Space.deriv_commute (v := i) _ (electricField_apply_contDiff_space hA3 t)]
  simp only [hs, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  simp only [Space.deriv_eq, div_eq_inv_mul] at hg
  unfold Space.div at hg
  rw [fderiv_fun_sum fun j _ => (hEd j j).differentiableAt,
    fderiv_const_mul hJs.differentiableAt] at hg
  simp only [_root_.sum_apply, _root_.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, ← Space.deriv_eq] at hg
  simp only [← Space.deriv_eq, Space.deriv_commute (v := i) _
    (electricField_apply_contDiff_space hA3 t), Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hg]
  simp [FreeSpace.c_sq, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hg]
  field_simp

theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a b c h k
  induction h generalizing c
  case refl => exact ⟨_, k, .refl _⟩
  case' par ha hb iha ihb =>
    cases k
    case par ka kb =>
      obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := iha ka
      obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := ihb kb
      exact ⟨_, .par hd.1 he.1, .par hd.2 he.2⟩
    case refl => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .par ha hb⟩
  case' red_I | red_K | red_S =>
    cases k
    case' par ha hb => skip
    any_goals solve | refine ⟨_, .refl _, ?_⟩; constructor
  all_goals
    first
    | cases I_irreducible _ ha
    | obtain ⟨_, hh, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ ha
    | obtain ⟨_, _, hh, hh', rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ ha
    constructor
    constructor <;> first | assumption | apply ParallelReduction.red_I | apply ParallelReduction.red_K | apply ParallelReduction.red_S | apply ParallelReduction.par <;> apply ParallelReduction.par <;> assumption

  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by

  obtain ⟨g, _, hg⟩ := Nat.sInf_mem (s := (fun g : BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, fin_ℓ_lt_ℓ_add_one i⟩ => (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g).ncard) '' Set.univ) (Set.image_nonempty.mpr Set.univ_nonempty)

  apply ENat.coe_lt_coe.mpr
  refine (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 (show hammingDist f g ≤ (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g).ncard * 2 ^ steps from ?_)).trans_lt ?_
  · rw [Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card', ← Fintype.card_fin (2 ^ steps), ← Finset.card_univ, ← Finset.card_product]
    refine Finset.card_le_card_of_surjOn (fun p => qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β _ _ (Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right_of_le _ _ _ h_i_add_steps) p.1 p.2) ?_

  · rw [← mul_assoc, hg]
    have hb := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (2 ^ steps) (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (ENat.coe_lt_coe.mp h_fw_dist_lt))

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P f f' cs P' y
  have hP : P' = Polynomial.C (1 - r_chal) * evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs + Polynomial.C r_chal * oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs := by
    simp only [P', cs, intermediateEvaluationPoly, evenRefinement, oddRefinement,
      Polynomial.C_add, Polynomial.C_mul, Finset.mul_sum, ←Finset.sum_add_distrib,
      add_mul, mul_assoc]
    rfl
  have hq k := congrArg Subtype.val
    ((generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.2 _ y ⟨k, rfl⟩).trans
      (iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap ..))
  dsimp only at hq
  simp only [f', f, fold, P, evaluation_poly_split_identity, Polynomial.eval_add,
    ↓Polynomial.eval_C_mul, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, eval_comp, ↓←hq, hP, qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.2, Fin2ToF2,
    one_ne_zero, reduceIte, one_smul, zero_smul, zero_add,
    Submodule.coe_add, get_sDomain_basis, add_zero, normalizedWᵢ_eval_βᵢ_eq_1]
  ring1

  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, h⟩ := (Set.Finite.pi (fun _ : Fin 4 => Set.finite_Icc B T)).exists_lt_map_eq_of_forall_mem
    (by exact fun n k hk => hB (n+k))
  have key m : u (i+m) = u (j+m) := by
    clear hij
    induction m using Nat.strong_induction_on
    rename_i m ih
    by_cases hm : 4 ≤ m
    · apply @Int.cast_injective ℝ
      simp (disch := omega) only [hu, Nat.add_sub_assoc, ih]
    · exact congrFun h ⟨m, Nat.lt_of_not_ge hm⟩
  use i, j-i, Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hij
  intro n hn
  rw [← Nat.add_sub_cancel' hn, key, Nat.add_right_comm, Nat.add_sub_cancel' hij.le]

theorem putnam_1995_a3
(relation : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → (Fin 9 → ℤ) → Prop)
(digits_to_num : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → ℤ)
(hdigits_to_num : digits_to_num = fun dig => ∑ i : Fin 9, (dig i) * 10^i.1)
(hrelation : ∀ d e : (Fin 9 → ℤ), relation d e ↔ (∀ i : Fin 9, d i < 10 ∧ d i ≥ 0 ∧ e i < 10 ∧ e i ≥ 0) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = i then e j else d j))))
: ∀ d e f : (Fin 9 → ℤ), ((relation d e) ∧ (relation e f)) → (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ d i - f i) := by
  have swap (x y : _ → ℤ) i :
      digits_to_num (fun j => if j = i then y j else x j) =
      digits_to_num x + (y i * 10 ^ i.1 - x i * 10 ^ i.1) := by
    subst digits_to_num
    rw [← sub_eq_iff_eq_add', ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    simp only [ite_mul, ite_sub, sub_self, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
  intro d e f ⟨hd, he⟩
  simp only [hrelation, swap] at hd he
  have hs := Finset.dvd_sum (s := Finset.univ) (fun i _ => hd.2 i)
  simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
    Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_fin, ← congrFun hdigits_to_num] at hs
  intro i
  apply (show IsCoprime (7 : ℤ) 10 by decide).pow_right.dvd_of_dvd_mul_right
  have h := dvd_sub (dvd_sub hs (dvd_add (hd.2 i) (he.2 i))) (dvd_mul_right 7 (digits_to_num d))
  refine Eq.mp (congrArg (fun z : ℤ => 7 ∣ z) ?_) h
  ring1
